REQUIRED:
- If you have a specific PID, use it: kill PID, Stop-Process -Id PID, taskkill /PID pid.
- If targeting a container, use the explicit container name: docker stop NAME.
- If you have only a name pattern and no PID, STOP and ask the user first. Never assume it is safe to broad-match.

CONTEXT PRESERVATION — quality-first routing:
1. Agent spawns: call POST http://127.0.0.1:8613/search with {"query":"...","sources":["project:<abs path>"],"mode":"both"}, route by type (full/standard/lightweight)
2. Finding verification: ALWAYS quick-cop, never self-verify (confirmation bias)
3. Decision flow: simple (just do it) vs complex (workspace + agents)
4. Rework costs more than ceremony. Do it right the first time.
